title: Position
description: domain::types::Position, as persisted to positions.cursor (one JSON object per line) and reported by BrokerAdapter::list_open_positions. Decimal fields (rust_decimal::Decimal) serialize as JSON strings, not numbers, to avoid floating-point precision loss on money values.

trace_id.description: Correlates back to the signal that led to this position. Synthesized as a fresh id (not a real one) for a position DerivAdapter::list_open_positions discovers that this daemon didn't itself open in this process's memory, since Deriv's own API carries no equivalent field.

legs.description: Fill history. A Deriv Multiplier fills atomically, so this is always exactly one entry for a position this daemon opened.

size.description: Decimal as string. For this daemon's Multiplier contracts, size is the dollar stake, not a unit/lot count.

status.description: See domain::types::PositionStatus for the authoritative variant list; this document does not claim to enumerate every variant.

exit_reason.description: Set once the position closes; null while open.

stop_loss.description: Decimal as string, or null if no stop is set.
